card.name: Time spans in hours, days and weeks
card.fires_on: The time number or unit inside a time span, such as the 4 in 24 before weeks or hours, or the unit in 'over hours to days'. It appears in label text about onset, response or refill timing.

modes.label: Digit 4 in 24
modes.description: The 4 completing 24 before weeks or hours in a timing phrase.

modes.label: Unit starting a range
modes.description: A time unit such as hours or days at the start of a range that continues with 'to days' or 'to years'.
